frontmatter.name: agent-deep-optimizer
frontmatter.description: Audit and improve a Claude Code subagent definition (~/.claude/agents, .claude/agents): a 16-pass convergence loop over the delegation surface (description, name, precedence, collisions), delegation contract (inputs, final report, stop rules), capability grant (tools, MCP, skills preload, permissionMode, isolation, memory), safety, resilience, model/effort fit and the system-prompt body; fixes Medium+ in place, adds delegation evals and a smoke load check, rebuilds the hub registry and verifies routing. TRIGGER: "optimize this agent", "run ado", "agent deep optimizer", "audit my subagent", "agent never gets delegated to", "least-privilege tools for this agent", "validate agent frontmatter fields", "which model should this agent run on", "add delegation evals". SKIP: prompt text in code → prompt-deep-optimizer / pdo; SKILL.md → skill-optimizer / sko; eval suites → deep-eval-optimizer / deo; running an agent → that agent; missing or ignored agents → agent-asset-parity-auditor.
